newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain crash kills nine; most victims Japanese.
newsitem.headline: Spain crash kills nine; most victims Japanese.

text.p: A minibus filled with Japanese tourists collided with a van on Tuesday close to the cathedral town of Toledo, killing nine people and injuring four, officials said.
A regional government spokesman said the two vehicles burst into flames shortly after the crash, trapping some of the passengers inside.
"There are nine people dead," the spokesman said. "It seemed to be a chain reaction collision".
The minibus had 12 occupants, mostly Japanese, who were travelling from their hotel in Madrid to visit the popular tourist sites of Toledo, the spokesman said.

Local media said eight of the people in the minibus were burned to death in their seats and that the other victim was riding in the van. However, the government spokesman said bodies were burned so badly that emergency workers had been unable to identify them.
Helicopters and ambulances rushed the injured to hospitals in Madrid, after the crash on a busy motorway which runs between Madrid and Toledo.
